name: cleanup-after-commit
description: Remove the git traces an agent leaves behind: merged temporary branches on the remote and locally, stray worktree copies, leftover scratch files. Deletes only what is provably merged and never touches unmerged work. Use after a PR merge or a burst of commits, or when asked to "clean up branches", "audit branches", "tidy the repo". Not for disk space or chat threads.
